companyInfo.about: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited is an Indian public sector engineering and manufacturing enterprise, owned by the Government of India, Ministry of Heavy Industries.
companyInfo.headquarters: New Delhi, India / Manufacturing plants in Bhopal, Haridwar, Trichy, Hyderabad

itinerary.description: Gate pass issuance and safety video.
High-voltage transformer assembly and oil filtration.
Impulse voltage lightning surge simulation test.
Hosted lunch for students and faculty.
Dynamic balancing and stator winding insertion.
Interaction with BHEL Senior Technical Directors.
Conclusion of visit.

rules: Respect high voltage clearance boundaries at all times

experiences.title: DRDO Advanced Armament & Defense Systems R&D Wing
experiences.organizationDescription: Indias premier military research agency developing state-of-the-art autonomous weapons, radars, combat vehicles, and missile avionics.
experiences.shortDescription: Exclusive tour of armament design laboratories, ballistics testing tunnels, and autonomous combat robotics.
experiences.detailedDescription: Step inside the Armament Research & Development Establishment (ARDE) complex. Discover how defense scientists design ballistic projectiles, multi-spectral sensors, and autonomous drone swarm telemetry.
experiences.location: ARDE Complex, Dr. Homi Bhabha Road, Pashan, Pune
experiences.address: Dr. Homi Bhabha Road, Pashan, Pune, Maharashtra 411021

eligibility.additionalRules: Strict background verification and Indian citizenship mandatory for defense establishment clearance.

whatYouWillLearn: Ballistics telemetry, internal pressure curve modeling, and warhead dynamics
Autonomous drone swarming algorithms and anti-jamming communication protocols
Hardened embedded computing architectures resistant to electromagnetic pulse (EMP)
learningObjectives: Evaluate military-grade MIL-STD-810 environmental testing protocols
Understand embedded real-time operating systems (RTOS) in guidance computers

experienceHighlights.title: Ballistics Tunnel & High-Speed Imaging
experienceHighlights.description: Observe ultra-high-speed 1,000,000 fps cameras capturing projectile aerodynamics.

experienceHighlights.title: Combat Robotics Lab
experienceHighlights.description: Demonstration of autonomous tracked reconnaissance rovers.

experienceHighlights.title: Defense Scientist Interactive Forum
experienceHighlights.description: Career pathways in DRDO Scientist-B recruitment and research fellowships.

whyAttend: 100% capacity filled with active waiting list demonstrating peak student demand
Ultra-exclusive defense research establishment entry for selected students
Zero fee contribution funded by institutional research grant

safetyInfo.dressCode: Formal university uniform / collared attire with physical ID badge.
safetyInfo.requiredGear: Special defense security credentials issued at check-post.
importantRules: No electronic smart devices or smartwatches allowed past Main Gate security

companyInfo.about: The Defence Research and Development Organisation is the premier agency under the Ministry of Defence, dedicated to achieving self-reliance in critical defense technologies.
companyInfo.headquarters: DRDO Bhawan, New Delhi / Laboratories nationwide including Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad

itinerary.description: Highway coach transit to Pune.
Identity check, credential verification, and mobile deposit.
Walkthrough of indigenous armament breakthroughs.
High-speed camera imaging and projectile simulation.
Hosted lunch for students and faculty.
Unmanned ground vehicles and sensor fusion demo.
Q&A on self-reliance in defense technologies.
Arrival at VIT Campus by 08:30 PM.

rules: Strict adherence to defense establishment security guidelines

experiences.title: BARC Nuclear Instrumentation & Radiation Safety Complex
experiences.organizationDescription: Indias premier multi-disciplinary nuclear research facility executing research in reactor physics, medical isotopes, and instrumentation.
experiences.shortDescription: Tour of research reactor control room simulations, medical isotope synthesis, and radiation monitoring instrument suites.
experiences.detailedDescription: Visit the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre complex in Trombay, Mumbai. Discover precision neutron flux instrumentation, SCADA safety interlocks for nuclear reactors, and healthcare radioisotope manufacturing pipelines.

eligibility.additionalRules: Indian nationality verified via Aadhaar card required for Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) visitor gate pass.

whatYouWillLearn: Nuclear reactor control rod instrumentation and fail-safe hardware interlocks
Radiation detection using scintillation detectors, Geiger-Müller counters, and semiconductor sensors
Medical radioisotope synthesis and automated radiopharmaceutical cleanrooms
learningObjectives: Understand triple-redundant instrumentation and safety systems (SIL-4)
Analyze digital signal processing in nuclear pulse spectroscopy

experienceHighlights.title: Reactor Control Simulator
experienceHighlights.description: Full-scale interactive simulation console of Dhruva research reactor.

experienceHighlights.title: Health Physics & Radiation Suite
experienceHighlights.description: Radiation dosimeter calibration and shielding physics demonstration.

experienceHighlights.title: Medical Radiopharmacy Lab
experienceHighlights.description: Production of Technetium-99m and therapeutic cancer isotopes.

whyAttend: Rare opportunity to enter Indias founding nuclear research institution
Direct relevance for biomedical, electronics, instrumentation, and computing students
Fully funded educational exposure visit with zero fee

safetyInfo.dressCode: Formal university collared attire and closed footwear.
safetyInfo.requiredGear: Personal radiation dosimeter badges and shoe covers provided at Health Physics counter.
importantRules: Dosimeters must be worn on outer garment at all times

companyInfo.about: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre is Indias premier nuclear research facility, headquartered in Trombay, Mumbai, Maharashtra, founded by Dr. Homi J. Bhabha in 1954.

itinerary.description: Bus departure for Trombay.
Identity verification and dosimeter issuance.
Welcome address on peaceful uses of atomic energy.
Interactive demonstration of reactor instrumentation consoles.
Hosted lunch for attendees.
Tour of scintillation spectrometry and radiation safety suites.

itinerary.activity: Interactive Session with Senior DAE Scientists
itinerary.description: BARC Training School (OCES/DGFS) recruitment pathways.
Arrival back at VIT Campus by 05:30 PM.

requirements: Original Aadhaar Card (Mandatory for DAE Gate)
rules: Adhere strictly to Health Physics radiation safety guidelines
